;*** IRS Blue-Peakup Filter
;*** RQExTransmission at 2.0 volts USED IN NOMINAL OPERATIONS
;*** 
;*** The first column is wavelength in microns.  They second 
;*** is "RQExT", which is the product of the detector's 
;*** responsive quantum efficiency (QE times photoconductive 
;*** gain) and the filter transmission.  That is, if you 
;*** multiply incident photons/second at some wavelength by 
;*** RQExT at that wavelength, then you get electrons/second 
;*** contributed by the incident light at that wavelength. 
;*** These data represent the same curve that is provided in 
;*** the SMART software package, and represent a revised 
;*** (improved) version of the peak-up filter transmission
;*** curve shown in Figure 7.39 of the Spitzer Observer's 
;*** Manual (v5.0).
;***
